summary: Tested the new 'Seasonal Light Adjustment' feature (backend + frontend) for Skaegagamer app. Backend: 3 new pytest cases (settings PUT/GET roundtrip, winter-period symmetric lys-task time shift, no-shift outside winter) - all 3/3 passed. Frontend: verified via Playwright (mobile viewport 390x844) that the Seasonal Light Adjustment section renders at the very top of Admin (above Database/Banner/Appearance/Language), shows correct DD-MM defaults (01-03, 01-09) and hours default (3), hours input change immediately PUTs to /api/admin/settings with success toast and persists across reload, and the Overview winter badge (snowflake icon + 'Winter period - light shortened' text) correctly appears when today falls in the configured winter window and disappears when outside it, with lys task times correctly shifted symmetrically in winter and matching raw schedule times outside winter. All admin settings were reset back to defaults (03-01/09-01/3) at the end - confirmed via GET.

react_native_issues.issue: On web preview, tapping the picker fields does NOT open any visible date picker UI - console logs 'DateTimePicker is not supported on: web'. This is a known limitation of this native library (no web implementation bundled by default), not a code bug - the admin.tsx logic (Platform.OS branching, onChange handlers, immediate PUT-on-select) is correctly written for native iOS/Android. Could not visually verify the actual date-selection interaction end-to-end in the web preview; verified the PUT/GET persistence and the resulting shift logic entirely via direct API calls instead (which passed). Recommend verifying this picker specifically on a real device/Expo Go build since web preview cannot render it.

action_items: No blocking bugs found in the new feature. Backend season logic (is_in_winter_period, apply_winter_light_shift) and admin settings PUT/GET are fully correct and verified with real data (raw schedule times vs shifted overview times compared directly).

Frontend Seasonal Light Adjustment UI section confirmed at correct position (top of Admin), correct testIDs, correct DD-MM display format, immediate-save-on-change behavior (no save button) all working via hours input; date pickers themselves could not be interacted with on web preview due to @react-native-community/datetimepicker having no web rendering (informational only, not a regression - test on native/Expo Go if pixel-perfect picker UX verification needed).

Overview winter badge (testID overview-winter-badge) verified showing/hiding correctly based on is_winter_period from API, with correct DA/EN text and snowflake icon, and lys task time shifts verified symmetric (matched (winter_shorten_hours/2)*60 minute shift math exactly) against raw Schedule times.

Quick regression sanity check passed: Database section (Export button) and admin defaults render fine after season settings were saved/reset; Banner/Appearance/Language sections not deep-tested per instructions (not modified this session).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/season.py: is_in_winter_period correctly handles the year-wraparound case (winter_start > summer_start, e.g. Sept->March) via the `winter <= today < summer` vs `today >= winter or today < summer` branching - verified correct via both a non-wrapping test window (06-01 to 10-01) and confirming defaults (09-01 to 03-01, which DOES wrap) render is_winter_period correctly for a July 'summer' date.

backend/services/season.py apply_winter_light_shift: clean no-op guard for <2 distinct lys times and shift_minutes<=0, avoiding accidental mutation; uses set()+sorted() to identify earliest/latest robustly even with duplicate times.

frontend/app/(tabs)/admin.tsx: saveSeasonSetting() correctly uses a single shared submit path for all 3 season fields (summer date, winter date, hours) with consistent loading/error/success toast handling - good DRY pattern, no duplication across the 3 onChange/blur handlers.

frontend/app/(tabs)/admin.tsx: commitHoursInput() correctly guards against saving when the parsed value hasn't actually changed (safeValue !== lightWinterShortenHours), avoiding redundant PUT calls on every blur if the user didn't edit the value.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of interactively-testable flows passing (season section position/defaults, hours-input immediate save+persistence, winter badge show/hide with correct symmetric time shift verified against raw schedule); date-picker native UI itself untestable on web preview due to library limitation (not a bug)

seed_data_creation: No new dragons created. Reused existing dragon 'Sif'. Temporarily set light_summer_start/light_winter_start/light_winter_shorten_hours to non-default test values during testing, ALL restored to defaults (03-01 / 09-01 / 3.0) at the end - confirmed via final GET /api/admin/settings and final Playwright screenshot on Admin tab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seasonal Light Adjustment feature (backend logic, admin settings persistence, and Overview winter badge + symmetric lys-shift) is fully implemented and working correctly end-to-end. The only caveat is @react-native-community/datetimepicker has no web rendering support, so the actual native day/month picker widget cannot be visually tested in this web-preview environment - this is a pre-existing library limitation unrelated to the app code, not a bug. All other new-feature UI (hours input, winter badge, section positioning/testIDs) was fully interactively verified via Playwright including real backend round-trips. Season settings are back at their original default values (03-01/09-01/3) after this test run.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found requiring RCA. Only noted limitation: DateTimePicker web support gap is inherent to the @react-native-community/datetimepicker library (it delegates to native OS pickers with no JS/web fallback bundled), confirmed via browser console log 'DateTimePicker is not supported on: web'. Not fixable at the app-code level without adding a separate web-specific date input component.
